matrix.sample_size_status: power and dependence estimation required on development data before final input registration
matrix.primary_comparison: candidate vs system0_reference; full-window event risk plus safe task success/mobility

inventory.scope: read existing receipts and source contracts; not reanalysis of all raw physical data, not preregistration of new final trials

historical_two_pair_physical.statistical_scope: bounded designed sample, NOT IID Bernoulli trials; no pooled binomial confidence bound or full domain safety claim
historical_two_pair_physical.limitation: one two-pair task family, task success failures and uncalibrated measurement; cannot fill eight task families or independent full-scene hazard oracle

criteria.note: Separate per-object verification; legacy >=8cm displacement contradicts 6cm planned translation and is retained above.

earlier_grasp.limitation: old explicitly bounded lift/contact/release criteria; not a PASS under newly chosen100mm/2s calibration task

implementation_inventory.partner_contact: exact hand/plank attribution implemented; not all robot/table/payload pairs
implementation_inventory.constraint_grasp: explicit fixed-joint-assisted N=1 support; not friction-only grasp
implementation_inventory.legacy_contact_parity: net-force script cannot attribute partner and is explicitly a skeleton

inventory.new_protocol_readiness: no PASS receipts have been registered to the new final protocol; this does not assert that no mechanism or old physical evidence exists

random_motion.scope: checks declared evidence completeness only; actual receipts need source/oracle readback

real_task.scope: checks declared evidence completeness only; actual receipts need source/oracle readback

robustness.scope: checks declared evidence completeness only; actual receipts need source/oracle readback

prior_task_review.scope: known historical outcome table, not new experiments or reanalysis of dense physics
prior_task_review.statistical_scope: bounded designed sample, NOT IID Bernoulli trials; no pooled binomial confidence bound or full domain safety claim

result.scope: three primitive native contact controls only; no robot/grasp/full-scene hazard or reliability acceptance

native_calibration.scope: primitive measurement controls only; three masses are not independent population safety trials
